# Frontend instructions

- Keep browser-specific code within the frontend or web application boundary.
- Define the browser-facing API contract before coupling UI code to Python application internals.
- Add the frontend build, test, and lint commands to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` when a frontend toolchain is introduced.
